name: confirmed-ball-identity-corpus-v1
purpose: User-confirmed identity baseline for isolated experiments; boxes are identity crops, not localization ground truth.

confirmation.grid-scenes: User confirmed both 15-ball grids and that the 10 ball is absent.
confirmation.video-scenes: User confirmed both demo3 frames: complete opening rack and dispersed 30-second layout.
confirmation.small-checkerboard-view-006: User confirmed mostly white ball immediately below and right of board is the 14 ball.
confirmation.remaining-stills: User confirmed all remaining still-image annotations and all eight large-checkerboard images empty.

annotation_limits: User-confirmed identities; source still regions use preserved visual centers or manually estimated centers, with region boxes padded to include ball appearance.
The two video-frame regions are manually estimated from full-resolution frames; they are not physical center annotations.
Repeated frames from one camera arrangement are correlated and must not be described as independent validation scenes.

detector_reference.limitation: Detection proposals are separately measured, not ground-truth boxes; proposals on videos/stills are matched to manual regions only for the detection-conditioned score.

source.timestamp_basis: exact frame index decoded from constant 30 fps source; ffprobe verified PTS at frame 0 and CFR interval
